frequency_question: How often do advanced weapon co-production/domestication initiatives reach operational status within a short deployment window after initial signaling?
membership_rule: Includes state-level defense industrial base projects to domesticate Western or advanced cruise/precision-guided munitions under wartime duress. Excludes minor small arms or basic ammunition localization.

cases.name: Ukraine domestic 155mm artillery shell manufacturing localization
Ukraine domestic Bayraktar drone factory construction initiative
Ukraine domestic Neptune anti-ship missile serial production scale-up

coverage_note: 3 named cases representing the relevant class of high-tech wartime defense localization.
known_gaps: Extremely rare class of events; complex cruise missiles have exceptionally high industrial barriers compared to drones or basic artillery.
skeleton: Active wartime defense localization attempts for complex systems scaled by average time from public announcement to operational first-unit output.
multiplier: 3 observed cases, 2 successful within comparable tight timelines.
validity_reason: Defense industrial base adaptability rates remain stable over medium-term geopolitical horizons.
